purpose: Issue #52 language/market desks. A desk is a language and an audience, not a person. Both desks are operated by identity jp_independent_freelancer.

en_desk.state_reason: English is the language of every LIVE revenue asset in acquisition/asset-inventory.json except the three Japanese ones, so an English route can reach a verified destination today.
en_desk.positioning: Japan-based independent freelancer writing about AI, independent work, practical systems, and what Japan is actually like from the inside.
en_desk.notes: Prefer verified existing English revenue routes. This desk does not create products.

es_desk.state_reason: First-class contract, but held at TEST until two things are true: a localization QA pass is signed off by the owner, and a channel exists whose provider policy permits Spanish publishing. Neither is proven today, so no ES output may reach AUTO_PUBLISH_ALLOWED.
es_desk.positioning: Freelancer independiente en Japon que escribe sobre IA practica, trabajo independiente, sistemas personales y la realidad cotidiana de Japon para lectores hispanohablantes.
es_desk.spanish_variant_rule: Default to broadly understandable international Spanish. A regional variant requires evidence that a specific market is the target; no such evidence exists today.
es_desk.english_only_destination_rule: Every verified revenue asset in the inventory is English-language. An ES output routing to one of them MUST state that the destination is in English. Implying Spanish-language delivery is a blocking localization failure.
es_desk.notes: Not a machine-translation lane. Framing, hook, terminology, examples, assumptions, currency context and CTA wording must be localized, and lib/localize.mjs rejects an output that is only a translation of the English one.
